what_this_is: The enumerated honest-state facts that EVERY cut of this film must cover. A cut may drop beats from every other movement freely. It may not drop one of these. This file is the QC gate's input, not a reading list.
why_it_is_a_separate_file: So that shortening the film cannot shorten the truth by accident. A cut is authored against SPINE.json; the gate is run against this. If the two ever disagree about which facts are mandatory, the gate fails and a human decides — a mandatory-fact list that lives inside the thing it constrains is not a constraint.

facts_contract.what: `facts[]` is the FULL declared id space for the film's coverage. Every string in any beat's `covers` array must appear here, and every entry with `mandatory: true` must be covered by at least one beat in EVERY cut.
facts_contract.two_kinds: `mandatory: true` — the seven honest-state facts. A cut that drops one is a failing cut, no exception, no shortening. `mandatory: false` — supporting coverage. A cut may drop these freely; they are declared so that a beat's `covers` array is checkable rather than free prose.
facts_contract.why_one_list: The QC gate reads one array. Splitting mandatory from supporting into two files would create a second place for an id to exist, and an id that exists in one list and not the other is exactly the drift this film is about.
facts_contract.changed: 2026-08-01, during authoring. The mandatory seven were first held under a key named `must_cover` with no supporting registry, which meant every beat's `covers` array was unverifiable prose. Converting to one declared id space made the coverage field checkable and made this file readable by the QC gate being built alongside it.

the_rule.coverage: For each id below, the rendered cut must contain material that a reader can trace back to that beat: the beat's numbers tokens as rendered values, or its quotation verbatim, or its stated fact in the cut's own words. Presence of the beat id in a cut manifest is NOT coverage — the gate checks the rendered output.
the_rule.prominence: None of these may be rendered smaller, faster or quieter than the median claim in the same cut. An adverse result carried as a footnote is an adverse result buried, and burying one is the single failure this film exists to avoid.
the_rule.ordering: M6 is delivered as a movement, before M9. A cut that scatters these facts across the running time so that no stretch of the film reads as the honest state has satisfied the letter and broken the contract.
the_rule.no_recovery_line: None of these may be immediately followed by a line that softens it ('but', 'however', 'that said', 'on the other hand'). The adverse result is the sentence. It does not get a chaser.

obs.applies_to: every rendered artifact of every cut: narration text, captions, SVG, PNG, MP4 frames, chapter titles, file names, and the QC report itself

token_source.why_indirect: Neither this file nor SPINE.json holds the forbidden strings, because a list of what must not be shown is itself a list of exactly the thing. The gate reads them from the repository at gate time and never writes them anywhere.
token_source.extract: read the @limitation block whose id is `f31.obs-unauthenticated` (the contiguous run of `//` lines from the line matching /^\/\/ @limitation f31\.obs-unauthenticated$/ to the line before the next /^\/\/ @limitation/ or the first non-comment line), then collect from it: every /\b\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b/ (IPv4), every /:\d{4,5}\b/ (port with colon) and the bare digits of each such port, and every /%APPDATA%\S+/ path. Deduplicate. THEN REMOVE THE LOOPBACK ADDRESS 127.0.0.1 from the set. That remainder is the forbidden token list.
token_source.why_loopback_is_removed: MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. The first version of this rule had no loopback exemption, and running it found exactly one match across SPINE.json, honest_state.json and tokens.cjs: the loopback address, which the film must render because the operator surfaces in M3 and M8 live on it. Loopback is not a locator for the surface this prohibition protects — the limitation's own text says that listener is bound to ALL INTERFACES rather than to loopback, so the loopback address carries none of the information the prohibition exists to withhold. Without this exemption the rule would forbid the film's own invitations while leaving the real locators exactly as protected, which is a gate that fails honest work and catches nothing.
token_source.verified: 2026-08-01 on THINKER: the extraction returns a non-empty set after the loopback removal, and NO member of it appears in SPINE.json, qc/honest_state.json or qc/tokens.cjs. Its members are deliberately not recorded here, in this file's git history, or in any QC output — the gate reports only a count and a pass/fail.
token_source.gate_output_rule: On failure the gate reports WHICH artifact and WHICH byte offset matched. It does NOT echo the matched string. An error message that prints the secret it was guarding is the same defect wearing a different hat.

general.rule: No cut file may contain a numeric literal that is presented as a fact about the estate. Every such figure is a tokens.cjs token id, resolved at render time.
general.exception: None. Durations, frame counts and timecodes are production values, not facts about the estate, and live in the cut's technical block where the gate does not read them as claims.
general.why: This estate's governing banner carried six hand-typed numbers wrong within six hours; one was wrong within 176 seconds. A film cannot be corrected in a day.

general.rule: A cut may not render a beat at a truth_class higher than the beat declares, and may not render a register:intent beat without its INTENT, NOT A MEASURED CLAIM marker.
general.why: Relabelling is the cheapest possible lie and the one this estate's whole material system is built to make impossible.

general.rule: E. coli behavioural evidence is never placed in the same frame, sequence or sentence as Salmonella or Bacillus structural evidence in a way that implies one measured specimen.
general.why: The truth contract, and because a film's cut is precisely the tool that would make two datasets look like one organism.

general.rule: No material, light, room, caption or narration line depicts or asserts awareness, experience or life. The scene module was built with no caption channel so that it structurally cannot; a film has one, so this must be enforced by the gate instead.
general.why: lib/sp/control_plane/scene.ex:48-59 — the claim fence is structural there and can only be procedural here, which makes it weaker and worth stating.

gate_contract.name: film-welcome-honest-state
gate_contract.runs: against every rendered cut, before any cut is shown to anyone
fails_if: any must_cover id is not traceable in the rendered output
any must_use_the_word is absent, or any must_not_use_the_words is present, for the fact that declares it
any forbidden token from prohibition.obs appears in any rendered artifact
any numeric literal presented as a fact about the estate appears in a cut file
any rendered figure differs from its recomputed tokens.cjs value
any quotation's rendered bytes hash differently from its beat's sha256
the honest.witness adjacency rule is violated
SPINE.json's beat_count_by_movement disagrees with SPINE.json's own beats array
gate_contract.is_not_yet_built: TRUE, as of 2026-08-01. This file is the gate's specification and its input; the runner is written alongside the first cut. Until it exists this gate is PENDING and must be recorded as PENDING — registered but not run — and never as PASS.
